item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: No peace
item.description: Vice President J.D. Vance left Islamabad without a deal as the Americans like to put it. It was always unlikely any progress would be made to end the war the US and Israel started. Clearly, this conflict is far from over. Also, NATO has fallen on hard times. We explain why. CrossTalking with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.

item.title: Uncertain ceasefire
item.description: On the face of it, the US and Iran have agreed to a two-week ceasefire. There is not much agreement beyond that. Both sides have starkly different approaches and agendas. But one thing is certain: American military might has failed to subdue Iran. We are in a new geopolitical moment. CrossTalking with Marco Carnelos, Ali Mamouri, and Maral Karimi.

item.title: Blockade vs blockade
item.description: Trump claims Iran wants a deal “very badly” as the US blockade begins in Hormuz. It is not clear what this blockade aims to achieve other than further global economic dislocation. Trump is not only running out of options, he is running out of time. CrossTalking with Muhannad Ayyash, Esteban Carrillo Lopez, and Ali Alizadeh.

item.title: Rock and a hard place
item.description: Donald Trump’s arsenal of ultimatums, temper tantrums, and expletives are not delivering the desired results. Iran will not simply surrender; it doesn’t have to. It has many cards to play. Trump doesn’t have a winning strategy, Iran does. CrossTalking with Larry Johnson and Ethan Levins.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: Decoding the ceasefire
item.description: This is where we are: The blockade is not a blockade, the ceasefire is not a ceasefire, and peace negotiations are merely a prelude to more war. We decode the rhetoric of the US-Israel war on Iran. CrossTalk with Mark Sleboda and George Szamuely.

item.title: CrossTalk Bullhorns: End of order
item.description: It is an understatement to claim the US-Israeli war on Iran is a blunder. This war of choice has already made itself felt economically and politically, and is in the process of flipping the geopolitical chessboard. Everything is changing and there is no return to the status quo ante. CrossTalking with George Szamuely and Mark Sleboda.

item.title: Ceasefire limbo
item.description: It’s called a ceasefire, but the fighting continues. The US-Israeli war of choice has destabilized the global economy and strengthened Iran. Trump warns that time is running out, and he is right – for his presidency and failed strategy. CrossTalking with Mohammad Marandi, Luciano Zaccara, and Syed Farid Alatas.

item.title: Decision time
item.description: Starting the US-Israel war on Iran was easy, ending it seems almost impossible. America’s overwhelming military power has proven to be indecisive as Iran holds significant high cards. Eventually the global economy will force Trump’s hand. CrossTalking with Pye Ian and Nadim Houry.
